# Install with Docker

The OpenTelemetry Collector distributes container images for Docker. Run the collector with:

```
docker run -p 4317:4317 -p 4318:4318 \
  -v $(pwd)/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml \
  otel/opentelemetry-collector
```

Use the `otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib` image instead of the core image when you need exporters or receivers only available in the contrib distribution, such as the file exporter.
